page.layout: One printed title page, full width; centred title block; engraving in the centre; imprint below the engraving. Handwritten annotations and a stamp in the margins are not transcribed.

page.notes: The engraving shows a niche with a lamp and the inscription "ALLIS INSERVIENDO CONSUMOR". Handwritten marks ("Bcklib", "Soc", "Coll", "Rom", "Soc", "Sess") and a library stamp at the right are not transcribed. The top edge carries scanner-cut fragments, and the bottom right carries the "Digitized by Google" banner, which are omitted. The "Ꝺ" of the title is printed as shown.
